ios.desc:
Vodobanka is a simple tactical game where you have to control a swat team. It has no ads or microtransactions.

Features:
- Easy to learn
- Campaign with a lot of levels
- Simple UI
- Smooth animations

quotes.text:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=yio.tro.vodobanka&hl=en_US&gl=US

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vodobanka/id1516815669

Vodobanka is my personal go-to timewaster, but it's not neccesarily kid-friendly (though not gratuitously violent). At it's core, it's a randomly-generated tactical puzzle game reminiscent of Breach and Clear, and it lets you choose how long you'd like to play for (with settings ranging from elevator trip to DMV visit) which is a much appreciated touch. Don't know who made it, but my heart goes out to you for making a mobile game that doesn't completely suck.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Is there a iOS game for kids without ads?
